conceptual_origin: joint intervention of LA SEGUNDA VEZ + EL PRESENTE COMUN
task: first physical body perturbation P_phi, recovery, wash, then later SAME or ORTHOGONAL perturbation; no external reward or selector
critical_control: NAIVE branch experiences identical timeline/noise but no first perturbation
common_present: for mechanistic test, fast/current carrier is taken from NAIVE while learned slow/history package [m,theta,r,K,b,gh] is transplanted
credit_manipulation: ablations occur only during first experience; later test has identical credit suppression across all branches
tests: one-sided sign-flip across 64 fresh seeds; Holm correction H1-H4
robustness: each requires >60% favorable seeds and bootstrap 95% bound on preregistered side of zero

interpretation_rule.all_pass: the first experience leaves a relation-specific native imprint that worsens the later same perturbation in this ecology, and the effect is mediated primarily by r-credit
interpretation_rule.fail_H1_H2: diagnostic negative transfer does not replicate
interpretation_rule.H1_H2_pass_H3_fail: negative path dependence exists but r-credit mediation is not established

epistemic_note: this would support path-dependent return and trace-mediated influence, not adaptive learning and not consciousness
